1. Imagine your field of view as a clock face
2. Start at 12 o'clock and scan clockwise, pausing briefly at each hour mark
3. Focus on different distances for each sweep (near, middle, far)
4. Pay attention to anything unusual or out of place

Create clear, attractive signage with your prices and any special offers. You might want to start small, perhaps at a local farmers market, before setting up your own stand. Don't forget to keep records of your sales and expenses for tax purposes. Have you thought about which vegetables you'd like to sell first?
